sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Ashina Clan are the main antagonists in Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice.

sections.heading: Background
sections.text: Founded by Isshin Ashina, a legendary swordsman lauded as the hero of the north, who defended the land of Ashina from all military threats. The clan is now facing imminent obliteration by an incoming army. In a desperate attempt to sustain the Ashina Clan, Genichiro Ashina, the current leader of the clan and adopted grandson of Isshin, sought to kidnap the Divine Heir of the Dragon's Heritage and use the mysterious power of the Dragon's Heritage to gain an upper hand in the upcoming war.
